description: Whatever is sent, more is needed, because prices move and the needs are medical. There is no amount that discharges it.
energy_note: A bill never paid in full.

aspect: The transfer costs a premium and carries risk
description: Formal channels are restricted, so transfers run through informal networks at a spread, with counterparty risk and legal exposure at both ends.
energy_note: A fee and a legal risk, to send your mother her rent.

aspect: It delays the sender's own life by a decade
description: Deposit, pension, training, children - deferred to fund a household abroad. Measured at sixty, the remittance decade is not recoverable.
energy_note: Your thirties, spent on someone else's survival.

description: On Upwork, Palestinian freelancers often lose a further 20-30% of earnings to currency-exchange intermediaries on top of platform fees, because the standard payout rails - PayPal and Payoneer - exclude them while serving Israeli settlers in the same territory.
energy_note: A quarter of every invoice, to get it at all.
